top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks unite the magic-wavelength quantum-control principle with defining high-performance realization and independent reproduction. Katori and Ye form the most coherent, narrowly bounded conceptual-and-experimental attribution, provided the citation remains confined to the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks.
recusal_note: No direct connection to Katori or Ye is apparent from the supplied profile. My work and long-standing collaborations are in atomic and attosecond physics, but no relevant collaboration with the proposed laureates is identified.
